summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on the Spawn grounds, now anchored by a three-storey cob house around a living tree. Main combines configured forest terrain and vegetation with authored settlements, garden paths, residents and structures; procedural builders make the houses and grounds while actor, portal and interaction scripts own their behavior.
places: places/main - the live forest place: configured terrain and seeded vegetation support Spawn, neighboring settlements and routes toward Lumenvale and Hearthmere
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn and home grounds: cob house/interior, paths and plaza, creek, garden, picnic, wizard tower, gates, golem and residents
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene + x-1z0.scene - north/west neighboring structures and actors, including the outlying tower/warden placements
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared authored object placements for main
places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene + x1z-1.scene + x1z0.scene + x0z-1.scene + x0z1.scene - neighboring authored environment, route and wildlife placements
places/main/config.yaml - atmosphere, forest terrain, sites, grading/clearing marks, path and river corridors, and procedural decoration bindings
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry/default place, player and camera templates, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - composed player movement, gait, home interaction and delete-mode behaviors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, atmosphere, Spawn gravity, site/path/river marks and procedural vegetation
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - procedural multi-level home around the tree, with cellar, ground/upper/attic floors and roof deck
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#grounds-plan + #grand-avenue - visible flagstone paths link the plaza, home grounds and outbuildings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#picnic-creekside + #quad-garden - creekside patio hangout and four-quarter kitchen garden on the Spawn lawns
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#wizard-tower - procedural east-lawn watchtower with attached lights/plaque, floating runes and paired portal triggers
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded forest vegetation builders reused by decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for bridges and roadside features
scripts/lib/yard-kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by yard and garden generators
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/ropes.js - player movement, flight and rope tuning
scripts/lib/data/dune.yml, fairies.yml, pollinators.yml, golem.yml, wardens.yml - actor route/activity/appearance tuning consumed by behavior scripts
scripts/gen/warden-tower.js + scripts/warden-crystal.js - tower geometry and breathing crystal reused by the four lookout towers
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber(value,fallback), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - HOUSE, holesFor, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - DEFAULTS, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/gen/picnic-set.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/quad-garden.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/gen/wizard-tower.js - TOWER, cen, rad, WIN, hatRing, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/wizard-portal.js - onTriggerEnter(ctx,other)
scripts/gen/grounds-flags.js, scripts/gen/deer-fence.js, scripts/gen/lawn-sprig.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx) (lawn-sprig is non-colliding)
scripts/stone-golem.js - updateSchedule, legal(ctx,x,z), update(ctx,dt), ears.press; scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - update(ctx,dt)
scripts/fairies.js + scripts/pollinators.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx) manager entry points; scripts/dune.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx), ears.press
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material/site marks, scatter and derived ground height/material; marks grade paths, lawns, creek and clearings
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, locations, tags, initial state and fixed structure/actor relationships
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; high-frequency scratch in ctx.session
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/camera.js - player yaw/gait channels and camera view/eye/local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js / scripts/fauna-small.js, scripts/fairies.js, scripts/pollinators.js - movement/activity and animation state for their tagged populations
scripts/dune.js; scripts/tower-warden.js + wardens.yml; scripts/stone-golem.js + golem.yml - Dune lifecycle, warden patrol/greetings, and Mossback patrol/interaction state respectively
scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js - each gate leaf's open flag and hinge rotation; paired leaves coordinate through shared center/openBy/lead state
scripts/wizard-portal.js + scripts/lib/data/wizard-tower.yml - portal destination/cooldown behavior and coordinates; triggering player owns wizardPortalAt cooldown timestamp
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path/river marks + decoration layers -> terrain clearing, grading, lawn material and seeded forest/lawn vegetation; scene rows separately draw paths and structures
road marks in places/main/config.yaml -> route corridors; authored cells add bridges, dressing, signs and rest features toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
movement near rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in; player body/camMode -> camera view and visibility
interact press -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned press; pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna, catio and pasture responses
Dune press ear + scripts/dune.js update -> treat queue/spawn and Dune roam, eat, wag and pet responses using dog clips
fairy-keeper + pollinator-keeper -> scripts/fairies.js and scripts/pollinators.js read tuning and tagged rows -> terrain-following flight, activity clips, greetings and effects
stone-golem press ear + update -> scripts/stone-golem.js reads golem.yml keep-outs -> Mossback legal bounded-lawn patrol, greeting/bow and locomotion state
warden scene rows + wardens.yml -> scripts/tower-warden.js update -> ring patrol/look/greeting; nearby players trigger staff flash/chime/effect and press ear speaks a line
player proximity -> scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js on each gate leaf -> open state/hinge rotation; lead leaf emits gate creak/thud sounds

player enters wizard-portal-up or wizard-portal-down trigger -> scripts/wizard-portal.js reads state.to + wizard-tower.yml -> teleport to tower deck/outside door, player wizardPortalAt cooldown and portal FX
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns, reeds and lawn flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multi-level cob home and its furnishing family; parameters select item, dimensions, palette and seeded detail
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs and gates vary by points, width and style; stone style builds coursed limestone wall, coping, moss/ivy and piers

scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + scripts/fauna-ground.js and scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - shared large/small fauna behavior varied by species, geometry and animation
scripts/gen/flower-bed.js + scripts/gen/lawn-sprig.js + scripts/gen/garden-statue.js - garden dressing varied by shape, dimensions, palette and plant/statue kind
scripts/gen/picnic-set.js + scripts/gen/quad-garden.js - authored one-off west-lawn picnic and east-lawn kitchen-garden assemblies, parameterized by patio/garden dimensions and details

scripts/gen/grand-avenue.js, grand-gate.js + grand-gate-leaf.js and scripts/gen/warden-tower.js + scripts/tower-warden.js - repeated avenue/gate/tower structures and proximity/patrol actors varied by dimensions, orientation and per-actor tuning
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; separate scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are around (0,-27), while picnic (-11.6,-6.4), quad garden (13,-8.5) and wizard tower (30.5,-18.5) each have associated terrain marks/clearance.

Configured terrain path marks grade/materialize terrain and clear scatter; scene path generators such as grounds-plan and grounds-walk-coop-hive draw visible flagstone and do not replace those terrain jobs.

The den-creek follows its authored river points through Spawn under creek-bridge-avenue toward the back pond; the den-creek-banks path and creek-banks scene dressing are separate and should track that course.

Deer-fence run pts are local ground points; style: stone changes wall geometry and collider while legacy runs/gates retain timber-wire default. Tower wardens' state.center is the platform centre and must stay aligned with their tower.

Wizard portal row state.to chooses top/bottom destination from scripts/lib/data/wizard-tower.yml; wizardPortalAt cooldown is stored on the entering player's state. Keep coordinates in the data file aligned with portal trigger placements and tower door/deck.
